checks.message: Window 6 role mission, required outputs and completion-gate topics are covered.

Skill, design brief, taskbook, allowed design space, site sources, source registry, planning limits, standards/index/reference snapshots, schemas, review rubric, data workflow and current geometry status were inspected.

Capability, target people, spatial/data/privacy/accessibility/interoperability/lock-in/maintenance/sunset/pilot/rollback/IP/public-value fields are represented.
Participation includes notice, accessible/human alternatives, objection, review, observers, affected-group input and response-to-feedback; it is not reduced to a survey.
Continuous/quarterly rhythm, learning assembly and annual public version release are defined.
Sunset-at-admission, continuity, shutdown, credentials/data/assets, registry tombstone, archive and post-retirement verification are covered.
Technology-neutral 5/10/20-year evolution is defined without freezing the concept around 2026 vendors/models.

Current national-level legal/regulatory screening is separated from project governance concepts; no legal opinion or fake approval is asserted.
No new official exact SITE_BOUNDARY/KEY_AREA was found; provisional geometry is not promoted to official redline/statutory control.
Institution, budget, SLA, procurement, developer/vendor/university commitments and approvals remain Proposed/Unknown unless source-supported.
Historical concept assets are separated from current validation proof; old ready_for_review/self-check/manifest/PDF/figure states are not trusted as current proof.
Five intended template structures were independently parsed as valid JSON; repository directory readback confirms all five files exist.
No duplicate issue was found for the provisional-geometry scoring wording conflict. Issue creation was attempted but GitHub returned 403 Resource not accessible by integration.
